name: Mirra AI
author: mirraai

sections.description:
Mirra AI is a platform for scheduling AI-generated content for Social Networks and WordPress.
It features metrics-guided finetuning, parameterized CTAs and built-in SEO.

This plugin connects your WordPress site to the Mirra AI platform. You configure what you want to publish and when, and Mirra AI generates the posts and publishes them on your blog following your schedule.

A Mirra AI account is required. You can create one directly from the plugin’s admin page.

How it works

  1. Create your Mirra AI account (or log in) from the Mirra AI menu in your WordPress admin.
  2. Confirm your e-mail with the activation code you receive.
  3. Connect your site: WordPress shows its native “Authorize Application” screen and, once you approve, creates an Application Password for your user.
  4. Create one or more schedules, defining the content theme, angle and tone, the days and times of publication and your timezone.
  5. Mirra AI generates the content and publishes it on your blog at the scheduled times.

The plugin never creates users or passwords on its own. The Application Password is created by WordPress only after you approve the connection, and it is sent to Mirra AI when you create your first schedule (or right after you reconnect a site that already has schedules). It is used exclusively to publish posts on your site through the WordPress REST API. See the “External services” section below for details.

External services

This plugin connects to external services to work. Please review them below.

Mirra AI API

The plugin communicates with the Mirra AI API to create and authenticate your account and to manage your content schedules. The AI-generated posts are produced by this service.

Data sent, and when:

  • When you register: your name, e-mail, password and country.
  • When you log in: your e-mail and password.
  • When you activate your account: your e-mail and the activation code.
  • When you create your first schedule, or when you reconnect a site that already has schedules: your site’s name and URL, the username of the user who approved the connection and the Application Password created for it, so Mirra AI can publish posts on your site.
  • When you create, edit or delete schedules: the schedule settings you entered (content parameters, days, times and timezone).

Terms of Use: https://mirraai.net/terms
Privacy Policy: https://mirraai.net/privacy

Mirra AI Portal

The plugin contains links to the Mirra AI web portal (for example, to upgrade your plan). The portal is only opened in your browser when you click one of these links; the plugin does not send any data to it.

Stripe

Payments for Mirra AI plans are processed by Stripe. The plugin contains a link to the Stripe customer portal, where you can manage your subscription and payment methods. The portal is only opened in your browser when you click the link; the plugin does not send any data to Stripe.

Terms of Service: https://stripe.com/legal/ssa
Privacy Policy: https://stripe.com/privacy
sections.installation:
1. In your WordPress admin, go to Plugins > Add New, search for “Mirra AI” and click Install Now (or upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/).
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu.
  3. Open the Mirra AI menu in the admin sidebar.
  4. Create your account or log in, connect your site and set up your first schedule.
sections.faq:
Do I need a Mirra AI account?

Yes. The content is generated and scheduled by the Mirra AI platform, so an account is required. You can register directly from the plugin.

Why does Mirra AI need an Application Password?

Mirra AI needs permission to publish posts on your site. Application Passwords are the WordPress native way to grant this access: your regular password is never shared, and the access can be revoked at any time. The password is created by WordPress itself, on its “Authorize Application” screen, only after you approve the connection. Posts are published under the user who approved it.

Does the plugin require HTTPS?

WordPress only enables Application Passwords on sites served over HTTPS (or in local development environments). If they are not available, the plugin shows a message on the connection screen.

How do I revoke Mirra AI’s access to my site?

Go to Users > Profile in your WordPress admin and revoke the Application Password named Mirra AI, or simply uninstall the plugin.

What happens when I uninstall the plugin?

The plugin revokes the Mirra AI Application Password and removes its stored credentials. Only the ID of your Mirra AI configuration is kept, so your schedules are restored if you install the plugin again and reconnect your site. Posts already published are not affected.

Which languages does the plugin support?

English and Brazilian Portuguese.
